name: comp-324
title: OTP Verify Dialog
blurb: Modal for entering and verifying a 4-digit OTP code.
description: A shadcn Dialog with a 4-slot OTP input using the input-otp library; displays success on valid code or error on invalid, with a resend link.
use_when: Two-factor authentication or email verification flows requiring users to confirm a code sent to their registered…
avoid_when: When you need to support variable-length OTP codes — the slot count is hardcoded to 4.
a11y: OTP slots are fully keyboard-navigable; error messages use aria-live=polite with role=alert; focus managed on state change.
